github.not_configured: The GitHub App isn't configured on the server
github.invalid_pem: The private key isn't a valid GitHub App .pem

github.app_id_number: The App ID is a number: you'll find it at the top of your GitHub App's page
github.key_mismatch: GitHub doesn't recognize that App ID with that private key: check that the key belongs to this App
github.key_unreadable: Couldn't read the GitHub App's private key
github.invalid_installations: GitHub returned an invalid list of installations
github.too_many_installations: The App has more installations than can be listed
github.installation_gone: The installation is no longer valid; connect GitHub again
github.token_refused: GitHub didn't issue the installation token (HTTP {{code}})
github.no_token: GitHub didn't issue the installation token
github.invalid_repositories: GitHub returned an invalid list of repositories
github.invalid_total: GitHub returned an invalid repository count
github.incomplete_page: GitHub returned an incomplete page of repositories
github.list_changed: The repository list changed while it was being read; refresh it again
github.too_many_repositories: The installation has more repositories than can be listed
github.not_in_installation: Repository not available for the installation
github.pulls_forbidden: The GitHub App can't read this repository's pull requests: its installation needs the "Pull requests" permission. The operator adds it in the App settings and the account accepts the update.
github.write_forbidden: The GitHub App isn't allowed to write to this repository (it needs write access to Pull requests and Commit statuses)
github.invalid_pulls: GitHub returned an invalid list of pull requests
github.no_branch_head: GitHub didn't return the branch's latest commit
github.invalid_pull: GitHub returned an invalid pull request
github.invalid_files: GitHub returned the PR's files in an invalid format
github.invalid_tree: GitHub returned the repository tree in an invalid format
github.env_managed_change: The App comes from the server's environment variables; change it there
github.env_managed_remove: The App comes from the server's environment variables; remove it there
github.foreign_installation: This installation doesn't belong to the configured GitHub App
github.not_installed: The App isn't installed on any account yet. Click Install on GitHub and choose the repositories.

brief.secret_value: The value isn't included here on purpose. Treat it as compromised: it's in the repository.
brief.kev: Known to be exploited (in the CISA KEV catalog since {{date}})
brief.kev_ransomware: Known to be exploited, including in ransomware campaigns (in the CISA KEV catalog since {{date}})
brief.verify_code: Open a pull request with the fix. Once it's merged, the next scan of the repository confirms it and says so in a comment on this issue.
brief.verify_dependency: Update it in a pull request. Once it's merged, the next scan confirms the version changed and says so in a comment on this issue.
brief.verify_no_fix: There's nothing to install yet. Record the mitigation or the accepted risk in Tamandua's triage; when a fixed version is published, the next scan will say so here.
brief.verify_image: Rebuild the image with the update and publish it. The next scan of the image confirms it and says so in a comment on this issue.
brief.verify_secret: First check with the provider that the old credential no longer works. Removing it from the code doesn't make it safe: the next scan only confirms it left the code.
brief.package_all_one: {{package}} {{version}} ({{ecosystem}}) has a known vulnerability. Version {{target}} fixes it.
brief.package_all_other: {{package}} {{version}} ({{ecosystem}}) has {{count}} known vulnerabilities. Version {{target}} fixes all of them.
brief.package_some_other: {{package}} {{version}} ({{ecosystem}}) has {{count}} known vulnerabilities. Version {{target}} fixes {{fixed}} of them; the other {{rest}} have no fix published yet.
brief.package_none_one: {{package}} {{version}} ({{ecosystem}}) has a known vulnerability without a fixed version yet.
brief.package_none_other: {{package}} {{version}} ({{ecosystem}}) has {{count}} known vulnerabilities and none has a fixed version yet.
